producer_report.summary: I extended the existing xtask site renderer with decision briefs. A brief has a decision, two or more options with cost, risk and a risk level, Athena's recommendation, and a record link for every claim. Each renders as a self-contained HTML page with an inline SVG bar chart of risk by option. The renderer refuses a brief with no recommendation, a recommendation that isn't one of the options, a missing record link, or more than 120 words of prose. The word-count error gives the count. `cargo run -p xtask -- site` now also writes `decisions/index.html` and one page per brief, and the explainer index links to the decisions page. Waiting items are read from `records/decisions-waiting/*.json`, and an absent directory means nothing is waiting. I also added `docs/conventions/owner-style.md` with the owner's rules verbatim, the design note, and a CHANGELOG entry. Rating, rewrite and status links are named as follow-ups.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo test -p xtask`: a brief with no recommendation is refused with an error naming the missing part, and a brief with prose over the word limit (about 120 words) is refused with an error naming the count.
criteria_check.evidence: brief_without_recommendation_is_refused checks for 'missing the recommendation'. brief_over_the_word_limit_is_refused_with_the_count checks for the exact word count and 'limit is 120'. Both pass.

criteria_check.criterion: Run `cargo run -p xtask -- site` (or the existing site command) and `ls` the output: a decisions page exists under the explainer site, is linked from the site index, and each brief is self-contained (no external script or stylesheet references, checked by Grep).

The waiting_steward_proposal_brief_has_every_part test asserts self-containment. I did not run ls or Grep on the output. The snapshot has no waiting files, so that run wrote 0 briefs.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing site renderer tests still pass because the change extends xtask/src/site.rs rather than adding a second renderer; no change to athena.toml, defaults.toml or workflows.
criteria_check.evidence: All 57 xtask unit tests and the site_page integration tests pass. The change is in site.rs and main.rs is untouched. athena.toml, defaults.toml and the workflows are untouched.

open_issues: Nothing writes records/decisions-waiting/*.json from real Steward proposals yet, so the published decisions page shows 'Nothing is waiting' until a follow-up does.
Option cost and risk text in from_proposal is generic, not derived from the proposal.
The brief's source links are relative paths to records, which may not resolve on the published site.
I ran only targeted xtask checks, not the full workspace suite.
mistakes: The first build left WaitingProposal and from_proposal unused outside tests, which would have failed clippy. Fixed with cfg_attr(not(test), allow(dead_code)) and re-ran clippy on xtask.
learnings: xtask does not depend on athena-core, so the brief input is a plain struct in site.rs.
The site's index page is written by `build`, so the decisions link is added there and `render` is untouched.
Clippy with warnings denied needed a cfg_attr dead-code allow for the proposal constructor, which only tests use for now.
desires: A real source of waiting Steward proposals that xtask can read, so the site shows real briefs.
